text:
matt: heads up — promote to prod is blocked, CI failing at artifact upload step for release v2.14.3 :grimacing:
jen: error? upload timeout or checksum?
ci-bot: build #4821 — step 'push-artifact' failed: multipart upload aborted by remote (S3 503/RequestTimeout)
jen: 503 on push? last successful push was this morning, nothing changed in builder image AFAIK
sahil: saw transient 503s earlier in eu-west region — might be S3 throttling from large parallel uploads
ci-bot: log excerpt:
```
PUT /release-artifacts/v2.14.3/part?uploadId=abcd1234 HTTP/1.1 503 ServiceUnavailable
retrying part 4/12 after backoff
AbortMultipartUpload: uploadId=abcd1234 aborted by remote
org.apache.http.conn.ConnectTimeoutException: Connect timed out
```
matt: deploy-bot refused promote: "Promotion blocked: artifact upload failed — manual review required"
deploy-bot: Promote action halted at 3487654321 due to artifact push failure.
tony: can we retry the pipeline? or will it hit same throttle?
jen: we tried a manual rerun 2x, both failed. The upload pattern is parallel parts 16 threads, maybe too aggressive now
sahil: temporary mitigation: reduce multipart concurrency to 4 and stagger part size -> lower hot-spotting. But that requires a config change in ci-builder image or env var CI_UPLOAD_CONCURRENCY
matt: timeline? we have a customer demo in 90m. Options: pin to last-good artifact (v2.14.2) or slow-roll with reduced concurrency and manual oversight
jen: we can pin to v2.14.2 for the demo and re-run a throttled push off-hours. Need approval for rollback/pin from release owners
ci-bot: found last-good artifact: s3://releases/prod/v2.14.2/digest:sha256:abcde9012
jen: quick checklist to pin: 1) update release manifest to v2.14.2 2) set deploy tag to prod:stable 3) note in release notes that v2.14.3 push failed and will retry tomorrow
sahil: infra suggestion: create temporary upload queue in eu-west via SQS to smooth traffic — but that's not a quick fix for tonight
matt: decision: pin to v2.14.2 for demo. I'll update release notes and trigger promote. After demo, we try throttled push for v2.14.3 and run canary in staging first
tony: :thumbsup: I can watch the promote and rollback pipeline, ping me if anything flips to red
jen: I'll draft the release note and a postmortem template. Also creating CI ticket to add adaptive upload concurrency based on 5xx rate
infra-bot: created incident INC-2026-104: "multipart upload throttling — eu-west" assigned to infra. Link: https://infra.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-104
matt: thanks — proceeding to pin and promote now. tagging @tony for observation and @sahil for follow-up tomorrow
jen: documented steps and added the manual pin command in the thread:
```
# pin manifest
curl -X PATCH https://releases.api.redwood/v1/manifests/prod -d '{"version":"v2.14.2"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN"
# trigger promote
POST https://deploy.api.redwood/v1/promote -d '{"manifest":"prod"}'
```
matt: promote started — deploy-bot acknowledged. deploy-bot: promotion queued, will notify on completion. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Promotion to prod using manifest prod (v2.14.2) started at 3487655520
ci-bot: build/promote pipeline green for v2.14.2
jen: posted note in #release-notes and created follow-up ticket RE-1245 to reattempt v2.14.3 with throttled upload
sahil: will pair with infra tomorrow morning to implement adaptive concurrency and S3 retry backoff improvements
tony: watching the prod dashboard now, all good so far :eyes:
matt: closing thread for now — promo completed for demo. Follow-ups assigned: INC-2026-104, RE-1245. Will reopen if anything else pops up.
